name: Dong Il Steel Mfg Co.,Ltd
summary: Dong Il Steel Mfg Co.,Ltd is a manufacturer and global supplier of various steel wire products, with its market reach extending across South Korea, Asia, and the Americas. The company's diverse portfolio includes PC steel, stranded wires, galvanized steel, hard and bar steel wires, Mabon steel, and segyeong rods. Beyond its core manufacturing, the firm also operates a rental division. Dong Il Steel Mfg Co.,Ltd was established in 1959 and is based in Anseong, South Korea.
